lines.en: I set my foot down and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 我的气把空气烧得发白。
lines.en: My aura burns the air white.

lines.zh: 绿气拖在身后，我朝你走。
lines.en: Green ki trailing behind me, I walk toward you.

lines.zh: 我的影子压过整片草地。
lines.en: My shadow sweeps the whole meadow.
My shoulders block the sky's light.
Each step makes the trees shudder.
I don't dodge, and I needn't.
Green light trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了你刚才站的石。
lines.en: I crush the stone you just stood on.
Dust becomes fog behind me.

lines.zh: 我每落一脚，红土就陷下去。
lines.en: Each step I take sinks the red earth.
This world shrinks beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我笑，是因为终于不用忍了。
lines.en: I laugh because I no longer hold back.
Ki churns across my back.
I roll my neck once.

lines.zh: 绿色的气缠上我的手臂。
lines.en: Green ki coils up my arms.

lines.zh: 我抬手，掌心聚起一团光。
lines.en: I raise a hand, light gathers in my palm.

lines.zh: 这片天，我一只手就能撕。
lines.en: I could tear this sky with one hand.
I exhale and the grass bends away.
I haven't felt this good in a long time.

lines.zh: 你听见我骨节的声音吗？
lines.en: Do you hear my knuckles?
I wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 气弹的余温还留在地上。
lines.en: The ground still holds a ki blast's heat.
My teeth are sharp when I smile.

lines.zh: 我想看看这天能撑多久。
lines.en: Let's see how long this sky lasts.
This earth is far too brittle.
So small, and still standing.

lines.zh: 你得仰起脖子，才够看我。
lines.en: You have to crane your neck to see me.

lines.zh: 你的气在我面前像火星。
lines.en: Your ki looks like a spark before me.
I don't remember your name.
You still haven't run.
I like that expression.
Look at me, don't blink.
My hands close, and you're gone.
I can hear you trembling.
You think I have no weakness?

lines.zh: 这不是你的战场，是我的。
lines.en: This isn't your battlefield, it's mine.

lines.zh: 你想求饶吗？再说大声点。
lines.en: Begging? Louder.
I can smell your fear.

lines.zh: 这片地能装下多少尸体？
lines.en: How many bodies would this land hold?

lines.zh: 你那把家伙，我两根手指就捏断。
lines.en: Two fingers would snap that thing of yours.
Laugh, I haven't had enough.

lines.zh: 这一界的战士，都这么弱？
lines.en: Are this world's fighters all so weak?

lines.zh: 传说赛亚人的气，还没放完。
lines.en: The Legendary Super Saiyan's ki isn't spent.
That one touched me.
I actually gave half a step.
Blood. Green blood.
You've only excited me more.
Pain makes me laugh louder.
Such a wound closes in a breath.
My ki wavered.
You'll pay far more for that.
I'm rarely struck.
My ki isn't spent. Again.
Food? I only want a fight now.
You'd trade that for your life?
I'm not hungry, I'm excited.
Throw it far, don't get in the way.

lines.zh: 这点味道，提不起我的兴。
lines.en: This whiff doesn't stir me at all.
I could swallow you in one bite.
Think that distracts me?
Set it down, then kneel.
I can eat, but I'd rather play.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，太可怜了。
lines.en: What you hold is pitiful.
You hit me like hitting a mountain.
My aura flings you away.
Don't touch my arm.
How far did you fly? I didn't count.
I didn't even blink.
You block me, move.

lines.zh: 这点分量，压不住我的脚。
lines.en: That weight can't hold my foot.
My body is harder than iron.

lines.zh: 你身上的骨头响了一声。
lines.en: Something in you cracked.
Again, hit me harder.
I only want to destroy.
That means nothing to me.
I would crush you.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴侣，我需要对手。
lines.en: I don't need a mate, I need a rival.
You're too soft, one touch and you snap.

lines.zh: 笑死我了，你居然问这个。
lines.en: How funny, you actually asked.
Get lost, don't waste my time.
I'm only interested in power.
My power belongs to no one.
Done talking? Then let's begin.
One squeeze and it crumbles.
This is tiny in my hand.
I pick it up just to look.
The debris on the ground is mine.
I step on it, it sinks into soil.
This little glimmer, too weak.
I toss it behind me.
You dropped it, I won't return it.
Spoils? I never collect them.
I grind it into powder.
Finally, someone worth hitting.
Don't go, I've only started.
My ki is overflowing.
You're here. Perfect.
I'll level this whole area.
You move first, I'll give you a step.

lines.zh: 传说形态的气，压得地面裂。
lines.en: Legendary ki cracks the ground.
Smile, let me remember it.
I'll use the Gigantic Beam.
The ki blast has formed.
This time I won't hold back.
You're my plaything now.
Breaking you will make a fine sound.
You have three breaths left.
I'm getting excited.
Come on, put some force in it.

lines.zh: 你的拳还没出，我已到侧面。
lines.en: Your fist hasn't left yet and I'm at your side.
I predict your next move.
I can reach you in an instant.
My afterimage remains.
Ki spins in my palm.
The ground has already cracked.
I'm unleashing the big one.
Not bad dodging, but not enough.

lines.zh: 我的笑的声比爆炸还响。
lines.en: My laugh is louder than the blast.
What are you waiting for? Help?

lines.zh: 这个星球没有能救你的人。
lines.en: No one on this planet can save you.
I'll give you one more chance.
Lift your head and watch.
The light is coming.

lines.zh: 这一下，会带走整片林子。
lines.en: This will take the whole forest.
I count one.
After it's done, where do I go?
Doesn't matter, fight first.
This punch punches through the air.
Where my fist lands, the ground caves.
You didn't even see the shadow.

lines.zh: 我拎着你的衣领，把你提起来。
lines.en: I grab your collar and lift you off the ground.
An uppercut sends you skyward.
I hammer down, the ground splits.
My elbow slams your back.
Can you hear me laughing?
Again, I'm not satisfied.

lines.zh: 我一拳打散了你胸口的气。
lines.en: My fist scatters the ki in your chest.
My knee rises, you should retreat.

lines.zh: 你飞出去的弧线很漂亮。
lines.en: Your flight arc is lovely.
Combo, three hits.
I step on your shield and advance.
Your blood splashes my hands.
Get up, don't bore me.
Green light tears the sky.
I land, the whole forest bends flat.
The shockwave scares the birds off first.
I laugh out loud.
This sky is too small.

lines.zh: 绿光撕开天，我一步踏出。
lines.en: Green light tears the sky; I step through.

lines.zh: 我的身体比刚才更高了。
lines.en: I stand taller than before.
Clods are still falling from the air.
I raise a hand and crush a stone.

lines.zh: 这片地记住了我的脚印。
lines.en: This land remembers my footprints.
I no longer have to hold back.
Ki bursts out around me.
You should be running.
I've come for the strongest one.
My eyes are green.

lines.zh: 这具身体，已经不属于我。
lines.en: This body is no longer mine.
Who's first?
The world goes silent for an instant.
Fire? I don't even bother dodging the smoke.
I land and blast out a crater.
Water can't suppress my ki.
The blast only lifts my hair.
The arrow lodges like a splinter.
This power actually pins me.
Hungry? My ki burns on its own.
Lightning strikes and I laugh.
The void swallows even light.
